import { onMounted, watch } from 'vue';
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router';
import pageBuilder from '../components/page-builder.vue';
import { useTemplateStore } from '../store/template-store';

const templateStore = useTemplateStore();
const route = useRoute();

async function hydrateFromStore(): Promise<void> {
  const isEditRoute = route.name === 'PageBuilderEdit';
  const isNewRoute = route.name === 'PageBuilderNew';

  // Edit: hydrate from stored DTO if available, otherwise use persisted template (do not redirect).
  if (isEditRoute) {
    if (templateStore.templateToEdit) {
      templateStore.setTemplateFromDto(templateStore.templateToEdit);
      templateStore.clearTemplateToEdit();
      return;
    }
    // If template is persisted, just use it (do not redirect)
    if (templateStore.template && templateStore.template.id) {
      // Already hydrated from persisted state
      return;
    }
    // Optionally, you could show a message or reset to a blank template
    templateStore.resetTemplate();
    return;
  }

  // New: reset + default label.
  if (isNewRoute) {
    templateStore.clearTemplateToEdit();
    templateStore.resetTemplate();
    templateStore.applyNewTemplateSeed();
    return;
  }

  // Fallback: if we have a DTO to edit, prefer it; otherwise treat as new.
  if (templateStore.templateToEdit) {
    templateStore.setTemplateFromDto(templateStore.templateToEdit);
    templateStore.clearTemplateToEdit();
    return;
  }

  templateStore.resetTemplate();
}


onMounted(() => {
  hydrateFromStore().catch(() => {
    // Keep the builder usable even if hydration fails.
  });
});

// Watch for route changes to re-hydrate template
watch(
  () => route.fullPath,
  () => {
    hydrateFromStore().catch(() => {});
  },
);
</script>

      role="switch"

      @click="onToggle"
      :aria-label="modelValue ? 'On' : 'Off'"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { usePermission } from '@/utils/permission';

const properties = defineProps<{
  modelValue: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Optional action name to emit when toggled (e.g. 'disable') */
  action?: string;
  /** Optional permission/action name. If provided and the user lacks permission, the toggle will be disabled. */
  permission?: string;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (event: 'update:modelValue', value: boolean): void;
  (event: 'action', value: boolean): void;
}>();

const permissionComputed = computed(() => {
  if (!properties.permission) return true;
  return usePermission(properties.permission).value;
});

// If `disabled` prop is explicitly provided (true/false), respect it.
// Otherwise, if a `permission` prop was provided, disable when permission is missing.
// Default is enabled (false).
const localDisabled = computed(() => {
  if (properties.disabled !== undefined) return !!properties.disabled;
  if (properties.permission) return !permissionComputed.value;
  return false;
});

/**
 *
 */
function onToggle() {
  if (localDisabled.value) {
    return;
  }
  const newValue = !properties.modelValue;
  // Always emit the v-model update
  emit('update:modelValue', newValue);
  // If an action name is provided, emit a generic 'action' event with the new value
  if (properties.action) {
    emit('action', newValue);
  }
}
</script>

name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

resources:

trigger:

jobs:

      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |

        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 22.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths

              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths

              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths

FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/httpd:2.4 AS base

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:22.2 AS build

ARG DEBUG_BUILD="false"

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

    && npm run build:meta-env-bin \
    && DEBUG_BUILD=$(echo ${DEBUG_BUILD} | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') \

FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/import-meta-env /app/

COPY --from=build /app/.env.dist /app/.env.dist

COPY --from=build /app/start.sh /app/start.sh

RUN adduser --system httpd --gid 0 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /usr/local/apache2 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /app

USER httpd

CMD /app/start.sh
# Admin UI

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

parameters:
- name: isDebugBuild
  displayName: 'Build in DEBUG Mode'
  type: boolean
  default: false

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: admin-ui

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      auditLevel: 'critical'

  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      debugBuild: ${{ parameters.isDebugBuild }}
      repository: mesx/admin-ui

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
